mostWorthwhile.text: Starting the processor was most worthwhile: it connected the visible grit to the less visible problem of dissolved contaminants and showed that the output is checked before drinking.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hose was straightforward, though its heating jacket and strainer added useful detail.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the extraction probe warmed ice beneath a dry surface and produced a cloudy trickle.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary; each action had a clear role in getting water from the ice to the tap, although each was the only available combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the practical details of making water potable were interesting, and I am curious what the expedition will encounter next.
